name: timemachine
title: Time Machine
description: Every session of the macOS desktop, recorded and kept to watch again. Each page load is recorded with rrweb as an append-only stream in localStorage — private to the browser by default — and this app lists the sessions by day and plays any one in a ReplayPreview. Turn on Cloud sync to mirror the streams live to a Durable Streams server (Rivet) so another device can watch too. The app is marked rr-block and rr-ignore, so the recorder never records itself replaying.
